# SLEPc comparison baseline, real scalars (tools/bench: compare.py --solvers slepc, tune_slepc.py,
# baseline_slepc.py). The exact conda-forge packages of the environment in which the comparisons on the
# measurement nodes ran, unchanged since 2026-10-11: PETSc / SLEPc 3.26.0 (real builds) with their own
# MPI build of MUMPS 5.8.2 (no patches, MUMPS' own block sizes), Open MPI 5.0.11, OpenBLAS 0.3.34.
#
#   conda create -p "$HOME/envs/hsolve-slepc" --file env/slepc-baseline-real.explicit.txt
#   export HS_REF_ENV="$HOME/envs/hsolve-slepc"      # where tools/bench looks for this environment
#
# For linux-64 machines with AVX-512 (Intel Ice Lake class or newer): the SuiteSparse libraries PETSc
# depends on were resolved for x86-64 micro-architecture level 4 (_x86_64-microarch-level). libfabric1
# is 1.22.0, which needs glibc >= 2.14 (the nodes run CentOS 7, glibc 2.17), instead of the 2.x that
# conda-forge resolves today (glibc >= 2.25; docs/DEPENDENCIES.md). On other machines create the
# environment from env/slepc-baseline.yml (same versions, solved for the local CPU and C library).
# Generated 2026-10-23 from `conda list --explicit --md5` of that environment on a node; each file://
# URL of the offline deployment is mapped back to its conda-forge URL, the md5 sums are conda's.
